title: Fix dependency artifact pattern for branch names with glob-special characters
summary: Fixed a bug where dependency artifact downloads failed silently when branch names contained special characters that minimatch interprets, such as commas, braces, or parentheses.
key_points: Branch names with special characters (comma, braces, parentheses, exclamation, plus, at, hash, bracket) were incorrectly interpreted by minimatch glob patterns
These characters caused artifact download to match zero artifacts and silently fall back to main branch artifacts
Special characters in branch names are now backslash-escaped in the minimatch pattern to be treated literally
Artifact upload, baseline lookup, and release lookup are unaffected by this change
